spans.s:
viṃśatí [485], f. twenty. [cf. εἴκοσι,
Boeotian ϝίκατι, Lat. vīginti, ‘twenty.’]

vinayá, m.
 —1. training, breeding, i. e.
formation of manners; and so
 —2. transferred
(like the Eng. breeding), manners,
good breeding, politeness. [√nī + vi.]

vínā, prep. without, w. instr. or acc. [1127,
1129.]

vinīti, f. (good breeding, esp.) modesty.
[√nī + vi: see vinaya.]

vinoda, m. exactly like Eng. di-version;
amusement. [see √nud + vi.]

vindhya, m. Vindhya, name of the
mountain-range crossing the Indian peninsula
and separating Hindustan from
the Decean.
